headline: Kroger misses sales estimates as middle-income shoppers join lower-income ones in pulling back; outlook narrowed.
guidance_note: Narrowed FY25 identical sales ex fuel to 2.8-3.0% (toward low end); raised low end of adj EPS to $4.75-4.80.
key_messages: Identical sales ex fuel +2.6% vs ~2.9% expected; revenue $33.9B missed; adj EPS $1.05 beat.
Interim CEO Ron Sargent: middle-income shoppers now under the same strain as lower-income families.
Shoppers making smaller, more frequent trips and cutting discretionary items; SNAP lapse in Nov. weighed.
Kroger cut prices on ~3,500 items as Walmart and Target also lowered prices; eCommerce +17%.
$2.6B impairment on automated fulfillment network drove a GAAP loss.

consumer.income_split: Middle-income households now as stretched as lower-income ones; SNAP disruption hit low-income shoppers.
consumer.big_ticket: Shoppers trimming discretionary purchases within grocery.
consumer.pricing: Price cuts on ~3,500 items amid competitive price investment by Walmart and Target.

macro_read: Financial strain is spreading up the income ladder into the middle class, with even grocery baskets shrinking - a sign of weakening real consumption.
